items.question: Which offerings and reason should accompany worship after placing the drop in the yoni-mandala?
premises: The drop has been placed in the yoni-mandala.
Worship follows with sandal paste flowers incense and lamp.
items.inference: Worship should be performed with sandal-paste flowers incense lamp and reason.
uncertainties: Exact internal compound analysis of gandhāpuṣpair is not explicit.
items.plain_english: He should worship with sandal paste and flowers, incense and lamp, and with reason.
